name: @simdad/tass-core
description: TASS's engine: LIWC-style category counting over OPEN lexicons (wildcard `stem*` terms, weighted categories, per-document + per-group rollups), a LIWC-format .dic importer (file-format reader - users bring their own licensed dictionaries), and KWIC concordance. Pure, deterministic, dependency-free. Bundled-lexicon licensing contract: commercial-ok sources only (NRC/LIWC/GI etc. are NEVER bundled).

scripts.test: node --test test/tass-core.test.cjs test/lexicons.test.cjs test/phrases-vader.test.cjs test/csv.test.cjs test/contracts.test.cjs test/lexicon-csv.test.cjs test/prepare.test.cjs
